```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests #new for reading in JSON
import io       #new for reading in JSON
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


```{python}
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
response = requests.get(url)
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))
```

_The most common, and probably the worst, delay is a late aircraft, with over 69 million flights getting delayed due to a plane being late. Carrier delays happen about 45.2 million times. Security delays are by far the rarest with only 200,264 occurrences._
```{python}
delay_df = (
    df.select([
        "airport_name",
        "minutes_delayed_carrier",
        "minutes_delayed_security",
        "minutes_delayed_late_aircraft"
    ])
)

airport_long = (
    delay_df.unpivot(
        index="airport_name",
        variable_name="Delay Reason",
        value_name="Delay Minutes"
    )
)

airport_long = airport_long.with_columns(
    pl.col("Delay Reason")
    .str.replace("minutes_delayed_carrier", "Carrier")
    .str.replace("minutes_delayed_security", "Security")
    .str.replace("minutes_delayed_late_aircraft", "Late Aircraft")
)

airport_long = airport_long.drop_nulls()

delay_summary = (
    airport_long
    .group_by("Delay Reason")
    .agg(
        pl.sum("Delay Minutes").alias("Total Delay")
    )
    .with_columns(
        (
            pl.col("Total Delay") /
            pl.col("Total Delay").sum()
        ).alias("Proportion")
    )
    .sort("Total Delay", descending=True)
)

delay_summary
```

_This graph shows the proportion of flight delays by reason. You can see that late aircraft delays are the most common, with about 60% of all delays. Carrier delays are the second most common with about 39% of all delays. Security delays are the least common, with them happening less than 0.01% of the time._
```{python}
delay_plot_data = delay_summary.to_dict(as_series=False)

delay_plot = (
    ggplot(
        delay_plot_data,
        aes(x="Delay Reason", y="Proportion", fill="Delay Reason")
    )
    + geom_bar(stat="identity")
    + labs(
        title="Proportion of Flight Delays by Reason",
        x="Delay Reason",
        y="Proportion of Total Delay"
    )
)

delay_plot
```
